datasets.title: Blood Transcriptional Endotypes in Women with Pelvic Inflammatory Disease
datasets.summary: By comparing blood mRNA responses of women with biopsy confimed Chlamydia trachomatis (CT) and/or Neisseria gonorrhoeae (GC) induced pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) to those from women with CT and/or GC infection limited to their cervix and asymptomatic uninfected women determined via microarray, we discovered important pathogenic mechanisms in PID and response differences that provide a pathway to biomarker discovery. Women with GC and/or CT-induced PID exhibit overexpression of myeloid cell genes and suppression of protein synthesis, mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, and T-cell specific genes. Coinfected women exhibited the greatest activation of cell death pathways and suppression of responses essential for adaptive immunity. Blood microarrays reveal discrete pathobiological endotypes in women with PID that are driven by pathogen invasion of the upper genital tract.
datasets.overall_design: Total RNA was extracted from whole blood collected in Tempus™ Blood RNA tubes of participants in this study at enrollment.
datasets.study_design: PID女性与宫颈感染、健康对照的全血表达谱芯片比较分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用盆腔炎患者全血样本

evidence.relevant: 直接研究 PID 女性的血液转录组内型与致病机制，样本含 PID 患者及对照。
evidence.sequencing_type: Expression profiling by array of whole blood total RNA; study explicitly targets mRNA responses via microarray.
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本级元数据无生存时间或状态字段，无法做患者生存分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较是PID vs 局限感染 vs 未感染状态，无药物治疗对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: disease state含normal histology且样本标题明确'STI -, normal histology, clinical manifestations of PID -'为健康对照，与PID组（如chronic endometritis等）可构成case vs control差异分析。
evidence.correlation: mRNA microarray（表达芯片平台）检出PID患者（子宫内膜炎确诊）的全血样本38例，符合表达定量且临床样本>15。
evidence.sample_source: 所有116个GSM样本均为全血(Whole blood)直接提取总RNA，未进行细胞分选或体外培养，符合blood定义。
